Method of Attack: Creates new Remote Desktop user accounts on Windows
Adds attacker-created user account to the 'Remote Desktop Users' group
Makes HTTP requests to a third-party URL to notify attackers of successful compromise
Indicators of Compromise: New user accounts in 'Remote Desktop Users' group

Method of Attack: Steals Telegram 'tdata' cache and settings files
Attempts to locate Telegram Desktop client 'tdata' files
Indicators of Compromise: Accessed 'tdata' files containing settings and cache

Method of Attack: Opens bind shells on infected computers on non-conventional port numbers like '54689'
Allows attackers remote access to infected Linux machines
